body:
Still an issue on 4.6.2.stable. Some additional clarity:

When holding CTRL and scrolling with the mouse wheel over the TileSet editor's physics editor, the zoom changes by 4x/0.25x per step. The actual - and + button behavior (as well as their keyboard shortcuts) appears to be different, and the resulting percentages do not match the mouse wheel zoom progression or expected zoom stepping.

Clicking + at 12.5% -> 800.0%. (x64)
Clicking + at 100.0% -> 6400.0%. (x64)
Clicking + at 6400.0% -> 12800.0%. (x2)
Clicking - at 12800.0% -> 200.0%. (/64)
Clicking - at 200.0% -> 12.5% (/16)

At the very least it seems like mouse wheel zoom and the +/- buttons should use the same zoom scale increments and progression. Zooming in and back out should take you over the same zoom levels, just in reverse order.
